brief: First run on this ledger: no prior watchlist or open setups, and OI history has no snapshots yet, so OI changes are null. Funding is at the 10.95 neutral reading on almost every market, so crowding is not the story; structure is. SOL, LINK and AAVE sit near the bottom of their 1d ranges and WLD broke its 1d range low with funding 1.87, the only clear funding deviation. The one tripwire hit, XMR htf_pullback long, is written up as a low-conviction setup; DOGE htf_pullback short is a near-miss (1.05 ATR from the 1d SMA20 against a 0.75 limit). hl-cycles reads mild risk-off since 2026-10-26 (feed stale, 10.2 h old); FOMC lands 2026-10-28. A 4h close back above range lows on WLD would be the first sign the washout is resolving; XMR closing under its 1d SMA50 would prove the pullback read wrong.
